name: hpos-runtime
description: HPOS local runtime daemon (M1) — 127.0.0.1-only authenticated RPC + a task registry whose every task runs in a supervised child process, behind a capability-driven executor router (native, Linux). Infrastructure only; no DeepSeek logic yet.
